1.consolidated_definition: Gallo “que tiene la cresta ancha y gruesa, parecida a una rosa” (CLJ, Memorias, p. 214). En República Dominicana le llaman encrestillao.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Rooster "having a broad and thick crest resembling a rose" (CLJ, Memories, p. 214). In the Dominican Republic it is also known as encrestillao.
